authority.decisions: TC14-01 through TC14-06 explicitly owner-approved; proposal bytes remain original Proposed archival decision packet

method: Static owning-module/source/proposal/test/plan review; external report only. No implementation, database, host, network, test or human acceptance claim.

recommendation.conclusion: Admissible within approved bounded local synthetic scope after coordinator freezes independently reviewed exact engineering contract. No additional product permission or topology decision needed for these engineering APIs.
recommendation.moduleBoundary: Task store owns its connection and ReadCommitted transaction. Every capture uses that same supplied connection/transaction after the shared run fence and before module row locks. Each module reads only its own tables.

apis.signature: Task<SyntheticRunCommandResult> ReadInTransactionAsync(NpgsqlConnection connection, NpgsqlTransaction transaction, SyntheticAuthorizedScope scope, Guid runId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
apis.implementation: Reuse existing guarded connection/database/scope and full SnapshotAsync integrity reconstruction through a module-owned EF context attached to supplied connection/transaction. Context must not own connection; do not open, begin, commit or dispose external handles; no writes.

apis.signature: Task<SyntheticReviewReadResult> ReadInTransactionAsync(NpgsqlConnection connection, NpgsqlTransaction transaction, SyntheticReviewScope scope, Guid runId, SyntheticReviewAuthority authority, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
apis.implementation: Reuse migration fingerprint, immutable seed, current/history/digest/category and authority verification. No seeding, second connection or transaction ownership.

apis.signature: Task<ArtifactReviewReadResult> ReadInTransactionAsync(NpgsqlConnection connection, NpgsqlTransaction transaction, Guid runId, ArtifactReviewAuthority authority, ArtifactReviewSource source, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
apis.implementation: Rebuild actual source.Packages within owning module and compare complete bytes, cached bytes/digests, current source and all event/receipt/current chains. Reuse existing ReadSources/ReadEntries/CheckSource. Do not invoke old delegate, seed, open/begin/commit/dispose another transaction.

apis.signature: Task<DemoReviewContext> ReadExistingInTransactionAsync(NpgsqlConnection connection, NpgsqlTransaction transaction, SyntheticRunSnapshot run, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
apis.implementation: Use real expected original finding seed derived from actual captured run/analysis; verify its digest against supplied-transaction finding read. No seed operation under fence.

apis.signature: delegate Task<PlanningTaskSourceResult> PlanningTaskSourceReader(NpgsqlConnection connection, NpgsqlTransaction transaction, Guid runId, PlanningTaskAuthority authority, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
apis.implementation: Invoke exactly once per fenced operation. Run read -> existing finding review read -> actual DemoAnalysisProjection.Capture once -> actual FixPackageSnapshot -> real ArtifactReviewSourceBuilder -> same-transaction artifact read -> real PlanningTaskSourceBuilder. Response reuses same captured values.

suppliedHandleChecks: Connection open; transaction.Connection is the exact supplied connection; caller-owned handles stay open/undisposed.
Validate exact configured guarded loopback synthetic database/server/role and trusted scope/run.
Shared run fence acquired before reads/row locks; defensive reacquisition only same connection/transaction, never independent callback ReadAsync.
Migration/schema integrity must be verified by owning module; current authority checked before history/accepted UUID inspection.

originalReferenceDto.minimalRequiredPublicFields: Reuse each entry.identity plus creation and plan immutable events. Each event supplies eventId, revision, kind, actorId, actorRoles, recordedAtUtc, reason, source (complete metadata ArtifactReviewSourceBinding plus planningTaskContractDigest), selected attestation references and recordedStatus/planningEventId. This supplies original run/input/profile/application/template/package/guidance/finding-review/revision provenance without another historical package DTO.
originalReferenceDto.originalContent: Render current coherent existing GuidanceOption text/prerequisites/risk/recoveryGuidance, finding validationGuidance and selected actual three FixArtifacts from existing package response. Label creation/latest plan metadata as historical references backed by server verification. Do not label current text as creation-era text after a source change.
originalReferenceDto.optionalCreationTextIfLaterExplicitlyNee: Server may project only the creation source selected GuidanceOption and its selected three fixed fictional FixArtifacts, plus findingId/packageId/scopedOptionId/templateVersion/templateDigest already in metadata, from its verified immutable canonical package. Avoid whole historic guidance/findings/packages/evidence duplication. Current draft does not add this redundant content DTO.
originalReferenceDto.history: Metadata source references and selected accepted event/revision vector; complete historical packages stay server-owned and are reconstructed there. UI does not claim independent proof of historical canonical package bytes.
originalReferenceDto.sourceUnavailable: Public identity/assignee/revision/status and bounded metadata events only; source/vectors/reasons/original/current package content suppressed; no actions. No fallback full unfenced analysis.

monotonicity: Every successful event, including stale maintenance, stores observed current source and selected vector separately from creation/latest planning binding.

Verify all task histories across run and current artifact histories; current run/finding/per-artifact revisions dominate every recorded observed source/vector. Equal complete run/finding vectors with unequal full package digest deny.
Creation/reconfirmation changes plan event reference; comments/status never implicitly rebind or change finding/artifact/health/maturity.

Read/denial/AlreadyExists/replay do not write source seeds/high-water. Selected attestation changes invalidate plan; unselected changes do not alter selected freshness but recorded-proof rollback still denies.
recommendation.schema: Task-owned additive schema only, full immutable canonical source versions, seeds, continuous events, exact original semantic command inputs/digest, current and metadata receipts. Preserve original accepted command fields privately so replay semantic digest is independently reconstructible. Fingerprint includes full column/type modifier/collation and all trigger states including internal FK enforcement. Atomic source/event/current/receipt and rollback-on-observer failure.
recommendation.canonical: Default System.Text.Json escaping, recursively ordinal keys, significant immutable arrays, string enums, lowercase D UUIDs/hex, UTF8 no newline. Stable task hash excludes source/state/command IDs. Current selected vector exactly3 artifact IDs, complete event/revision/state/source references; no reason/content in vector.
recommendation.limits: Reuse source 100000-record and 32MiB limits; reasons/comments exact nonblank <=2000 UTF16 and valid Unicode roundtrip; JS-safe revisions; closed16384-byte command body. Do not infer customer retention, operational scale or arbitrary history pagination behavior.
recommendation.compatibility: Eleventh exact profile/application, fourteen exact frozen fields, unchanged artifact contract/template locks plus task contract lock. New nullable run lock omitted on ten prior profiles; strict validator branches only. Existing historical source/inputs/goldens/migrations unchanged. HTTP planningTasks=null is an intentional additional response field required by contract, not literally identical entire old wire JSON.
requiredIndependentEvidence: TC14-T01 through TC14-T12, actual source composition and independent canonical/command/source oracles.
Same connection/transaction capture and barrier tests against actual artifact/finding/assessment writers; supplied-handle ownership and no nested fence.
All lifecycle/reconfirm/reopen/replay/duplicate precedence and all denied branches produce no writes.
Stale maintenance sourceB then rollbackA, cross-artifact/cross-task run high-water, original option/attestation membership.
Source unavailable authorized metadata-only/no actions; corrupt history/schema/authority payload-free.
Ten historical frozen envelopes and exact null/no-authority behavior; whole coherent current response and inert text/keyboard/reflow/late replies.

implementationHazards: Existing ArtifactReviewSourceBuilder binds old application constant; new conditional branch must emit actual new application while preserving old constants and thirteen-field behavior.
Do not silently broaden source validators or alter old fixed review migration bytes.
Source-unavailable task metadata must not restore existing DemoArtifactReviewService unfenced analysis fallback.
Persist original semantic command inputs privately; a digest alone is insufficient for complete reconstruction.
limitations: Static design only; no runtime source API implementation inspected because not yet written.
No deployed security, customer data, CSV, retention or production release authority.
